country.match: Match each mountain to its country.
country.odd: Three of these mountains are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Mount Everest
rows.description: Earth's highest mountain above sea level, located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas
rows.hook: is the tallest mountain above sea level on the entire planet

rows.label: Mount Kailash
rows.hook: is considered sacred by four major religions and has never been climbed

rows.label: K2
rows.hook: is the second-highest peak on Earth, nicknamed the Savage Mountain for its danger

rows.label: Langtang Lirung
rows.hook: towers over a popular himalayan trekking region and can sometimes be seen from kathmandu on clear days

rows.label: Aconcagua
rows.description: highest mountain in both the Southern and the Western Hemispheres (6967 m)
rows.hook: is the highest peak in the Americas and popular with climbers seeking a non-technical summit

rows.label: Kanchenjunga
rows.description: third highest mountain in the world, in Nepal and India
rows.hook: is the third-highest peak on Earth and traditionally left just short of its true summit out of respect

rows.label: Nanga Parbat
rows.description: mountain in Pakistan; 9th highest in the world
rows.hook: is nicknamed Killer Mountain for its steep, deadly slopes

rows.label: Annapurna I
rows.hook: has one of the highest fatality rates of any major peak climbers have attempted to summit

rows.label: Broad Peak
rows.hook: rises near K2 in the karakoram range and gets its name from an unusually wide summit ridge

rows.label: Lhotse
rows.hook: stands right beside the world's tallest peak and shares part of its climbing route

rows.label: Gangkhar Puensum
rows.hook: is believed to be the tallest mountain on Earth that no one has ever climbed to the top of

rows.label: Manaslu
rows.description: mountain in Nepal; eighth highest mountain in the world
rows.hook: was first climbed to its summit by a pioneering Japanese expedition

rows.label: Shishapangma
rows.hook: is the only one of the world's very tallest peaks that lies entirely within one country

rows.label: Nanda Devi
rows.hook: is so sacred that climbing to its summit has been banned for decades
